title: 工资范围内员工查询
problem_statement_md:
假设有个员工表**staff**，数据如下图：

![](/content/assets/280789dd0382390f960f.jpeg)

请写一个查询，输出工资`salary`在**1500**和**1900**之间的员工名字`firstname`。
problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]The BETWEEN Operator[/h1][/s0l0!-header]

You are given the following table named [b]staff[/b] : [img id="4470" width="100%"]
Write a query to output the [b]names[/b] of employees whose salaries are [b]between 1500 and 1900[/b].
[note]Combine the [b]WHERE[/b] statement with the [b]BETWEEN[/b] operator![/note]
hint_md: 将**WHERE**语句与**BETWEEN**操作符结合起来!

code_templates.solution_code:
SELECT firstname
FROM staff
WHERE salary BETWEEN 1500 AND 1900
code_templates.prepend_code:
CREATE TABLE staff (
  id int,
  firstname VARCHAR(128),
  lastname VARCHAR(128),
  salary int 
);

INSERT INTO staff (id,firstname,lastname,salary)
VALUES
(1,'John','Smith',1500),
(2,'David','Gibson',1750),
(3,'Lisa','Anderson',1300),
(4,'Seth','Gray',2000),
(5,'Nelson','Gross',1900);
